name: Chain Block CB-I / CB-II Series
desc: ABLE CB-I series chain block (manual chain hoist) for general and heavy lifting. The heat-treated ISO Grade T (900 N/mm²) load chain is approved to DIN 5684, and a fail-safe double-pawl brake keeps the load secure even if one pawl fails. Wider, easier-handling hooks yield rather than break under overload; the ribbed gear case gives accurate gear centering, and the load sheave runs on sealed roller bearings with wet friction discs for long life. Individually proof-load tested with a serial number. Conforms to EN 13157:2004+A1:2009, ANSI/ASME B30.21, AS 1418.2 and SANS 1636. WLL 0.5–20 t, standard lift 3 m.

specs.label: Bearings
specs.value: Load sheave on sealed roller bearings
